summary: FTI Consulting filed an 8-K to report entry into a Third Amendment and Restatement Credit Agreement with Bank of America-led lenders. The agreement increases its unsecured revolving facility from prior limits to $1.5 billion, extends maturity to June 30, 2031, and allows incremental facilities up to $500 million or 100% of consolidated EBITDA plus unlimited additional capacity subject to a 4.00x net leverage ratio. Interest rates are based on SOFR plus a credit-rating-dependent margin. A $300 million term loan due 2029 remains unchanged. No price per share, premium, or special-situation structural terms exist; this is a routine credit facility refinancing. No arbitrage angle applies.
